blocked_sentences: Lupari Shield {1}{G} (Sorcery — Adventure): printed text absent from the packet and from the local catalog

needs.what: the packet and the catalog row (data/catalog/cards.sqlite, layout 'adventure', type line 'Legendary Creature — Alien Dog Soldier // Sorcery — Adventure', mana cost '{4}{G} // {1}{G}') carry no text for the Adventure half Lupari Shield: back_oracle_text and back_name are empty, back_face is {}, oracle_text holds only the creature half, and the local MTGJSON deck file (ParadoxPower_WHO) lists only side 'a'. The packet builder needs to fill the Adventure face (name, cost, type line, text) from card_faces so the card can be written as a front plus a second_face with adventure: true and second_face_zone 'hand'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The front is fully expressible (keywords vigilance, trample, haste; an 'attacks' trigger with source self whose effect is add_counters +1/+1 over {zone: battlefield, controller: you, types: [Creature], subtypes: [Human]}), and second_face + adventure: true is the right chassis for the half, as Beanstalk Giant // Fertile Footsteps uses. But the Adventure half's sentences cannot be written from the packet without inventing them, and an answer with the front alone would be a creature that can never be cast as Lupari Shield -- the same invisibility recorded on james_wandering_dad_follow_him
